items.informal_name: Constant weight function on finite type ι
items.informal_description: The constant function from a finite type $\iota$ to $\mathbb{R}$ that maps every element to $\frac{1}{\#\iota}$, where $\#\iota$ denotes the cardinality of $\iota$.

items.informal_name: Weighted Sum Homomorphism for Finite Support Functions
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [Finite σ] (w : σ → ℕ), (∀ (x : σ), w x ≠ 0) → ∀ (n : ℕ), {d | (Finsupp.weight w) d ≤ n}.Finite
items.informal_description: The additive homomorphism from the space of finite support functions $ \sigma \to_0 R $ to the module $ M $ maps each function $ d $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} d(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $. This homomorphism preserves addition and is defined using a fixed family of vectors $ \{v_i\}_{i \in \sigma} $.

items.informal_name: Centroid weights for a finite set
items.type: (k : Type u_1) → [DivisionRing k] → {ι : Type u_4} → Finset ι → ι → k
items.informal_description: The function assigns to each element of the finite set $ s $ the uniform weight $ 1/#s $, where $ #s $ denotes the cardinality of $ s $ and the weight is computed as the multiplicative inverse in the division ring $ k $. This defines a constant function mapping every element of the index type $ \iota $ to the equal weighting factor for the centroid computation.

items.informal_name: Weighted Sum Evaluation: $ \text{weight } w f = \sum_{i \in \text{support } f} c_i \cdot w(i) $
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight w) f = f.sum fun i c => c • w i
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 R $, the weight function applied to $ f $ is equal to the sum over all $ i $ in the support of $ f $ of $ c \cdot w(i) $, where $ c $ is the coefficient of $ i $ in $ f $ and $ w : \sigma \to M $ is a function assigning vectors to indices.

items.informal_name: Centroid weights indicator function for a finite set
items.type: (k : Type u_1) → [DivisionRing k] → {ι : Type u_4} → Finset ι → ι → k
items.informal_description: The function assigns to each element of the finite set $ s $ the uniform weight $ 1/#s $ (where $ #s $ denotes the cardinality of $ s $) if the element belongs to $ s $, and zero otherwise. This is achieved by applying the indicator function of $ s $ to the uniform centroid weights defined on the division ring $ k $.

items.name: Finset.sum_add_distrib
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M} : ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x) = ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x

request.query: The sum of (d j + e j) divided by r j equals sum d j/r j plus sum e j/r j

items.name: EReal.div_right_distrib_of_nonneg
items.type: ∀ {a b c : EReal}, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → (a + b) / c = a / c + b / c

items.name: ENNReal.add_div
items.type: ∀ {a b c : ENNReal}, (a + b) / c = a / c + b / c

items.name: Finset.sum_div
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : DivisionSemiring K] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K) (a : K),
  (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / a = ∑ i ∈ s, f i / a

items.name: Rat.add_divInt
